name: AccessProtocol
description: Access protocols (i.e. communication protocols) for fetching a data file, following the vocabulary defined in the GA4GH DRS specification (renamed from the FGA-WG enum AccessMethods to avoid the near-clash with the AccessMethod class).

values.name: s3
values.description: Amazon S3 and other S3-compatible bucket.

values.name: gsiftp
values.description: GridFTP protocol (an extension of the File Transfer Protocol (FTP) for grid computing).

values.name: globus
values.description: Data transfer via the Globus research cyberinfrastructure (https://www.globus.org/.)

values.name: htsget
values.description: GA4GH HTSget standard for retrieving subsections of genomic data (https://www.ga4gh.org/product/htsget/).

values.name: https
values.description: Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure, the standard encrypted protocol used on the web.

values.name: file
values.description: For local files accessible via a file URI (e.g., file://path/to/file).

name: BiospecimenClassification
description: Vocabulary from the ENCODE model describing the general category of biospecimen (see "Properties->classification" in https://www.encodeproject.org/profiles/biosample_type).

name: ValueType
description: Types of data values associated with sequence features or edges. (Renamed from the FGA-WG enum DataTypes to avoid the near-clash with the ONGA DataType content vocabulary.)

values.name: multiple
values.description: Multiple types of values are associated (e.g. both integer and string).
